list: The official 55-trophy PS5 list, as published by PlayStation and collected by PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements (Nov 2026)
notes: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline; there are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies.

Platinum estimate: around 200 hours (PowerPyx via GTA Zone). No mission replay and no New Game Plus — keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission (15 manual save slots plus one autosave).
Only one trophy is flagged as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude (Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation).
Cheats switch off trophies and saving on a trophy save.
Trophy names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written in our own words; each cites its source.

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies, the full official list
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one pops by itself: earn the other 54 trophies and the Platinum follows at once, usually right after A Long Road (100% completion) lands. There is nothing extra to do for it, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below, not a task of its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops with the credits of the intro. It is unmissable — just play through the start of the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Before you leave the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that does not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. This is also the chapter where the world opens up: switching between Jason and Lucia unlocks after Breakfast Run, and most free-roam trophies become available from here on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Robbery tools arrive in this chapter — Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun for jewelry-store robberies — so it is a good time to start the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks bank-vault robberies, which feed Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Because the game has no mission replay, keep a manual save from just before the final mission — it is your safety net if you want to replay the ending or mop up anything story-adjacent afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It matters beyond its own trophy: character switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it, which is what makes the partner trophies possible.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops automatically when the mission ends — no special objective to chase inside it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it is unmissable and pops as the mission completes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Just play the story through; there is no extra condition attached to this one.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable; play the story through and it lands on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The longest trophy on the list and the real Platinum gate. The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts — so keep chipping at it all game. It pulls together the story, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries; the big counts are 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Budget around 200 hours for the Platinum as a whole, and do not use cheats on this save — they switch trophies and saving off.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the 250. Keep going past it: 100% completion wants 300, so every stunt you land now is progress twice over. Work it in whenever you travel — jump the ramps you pass instead of driving around them.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once — races, fishing, the arcade games, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. You do not need to be good at any of them; one try each is enough, so use this trophy as your tour of what Leonida offers and tick the activities off early.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are two shooting ranges, with 42 gold medals between them, and you need gold in every challenge. Take it weapon by weapon and learn each challenge's scoring before burning attempts — steady aim beats rushing, and the range is always there between story missions.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. You only need one win per location, not every race, so move on as soon as a location is won and come back only for the ones left.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Spread across race types and locations; each new event you win is one closer, and the variety also feeds the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing also feeds your Combat Focus meter — each fish landed adds roughly a tenth — so the time spent here helps Gunslinger later.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four in-game arcade games. Pick whichever you enjoy most; a single completion is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand through to its last mission. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead — so finish it for this trophy, not for that counter.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Side strands stay available after the story ends, so there is no rush — but do not leave it until the very end either, in case its missions gate anything else you want.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand through to its last mission. Like Andy's and Tyrone's, Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so it needs finishing on its own terms.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have trophies of their own. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish, so you can see which ones moved it and which did not.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands are free-roam content, so they stay open after the credits — finish Randy's whenever it fits your route.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand through to its last mission. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so finish it for this trophy itself; his Chapter 3 timed race (Race Against Yago, marked with an hourglass) is worth saving before you attempt it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only one guides flag as possibly missable, and the reason to keep chapter saves. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. The one that can vanish is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time), follow her out to the balcony and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and nobody has confirmed the trophy can be finished without it — so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Bring your partner to every outdoor spot: each spot should count twice if both characters meditate there.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel's hunting questline — it is Jason-only — and take down the unique animal it sends you after, following its target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, so take the careful shot rather than the fast one.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are a slow hunt across Leonida, so pick up sets as you explore rather than leaving them all for the end — the WAiNK app helps you spot things as you travel.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan things as you go — scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so this trophy and that one progress together while you drive.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges, listed under Progress > Challenges, in eight groups of ten. Many complete on their own while you play; 100% completion wants 70, so keep pushing past 50 rather than stopping here.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose the cops completely and escape the red heat zone — leaving the flashing search area is not enough; the trophy only pops once you are out of the heat. The easy pairing is a bank-vault job: vaults give you a 4-star level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this and Maximum Withdrawal together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in first, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are left only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so keep the wanted level alive between shops. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so wait a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The quick way is the WAiNK app: scanning a vehicle counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of only counting what you sit in. 100% completion wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming — and you need 5 takedowns inside one use of it. Each fish you land adds about a tenth to the Focus meter, so fish first to fill it. Then pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus, which buys you the time for all five.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Climb to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Chapter 3 job, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry-store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if anyone spots you, reload and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. Five vaults earn the trophy, but 100% completion wants all eight, so keep going.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away clean. Like Hot Together, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone — slipping out of the flashing search area is not enough.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Cover the whole map of Leonida — every region, not just Vice City. It fills in naturally as you chase the other exploration trophies (vehicles, WAiNK spots, meditation spots), so treat it as a reason to keep driving somewhere new instead of fast-travelling everywhere.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way if you keep clearing them — and clearing them also feeds Gunslinger, since their guards make good Combat Focus targets.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description is the clue: a cocktail, with a view, on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar along Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. No guide has published a confirmed exact spot yet, so treat the description itself — not any single bar name — as the reliable part, and check the community guides linked in the sources if this one does not pop on your first try.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description says it all: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style — drive a car out through the front of the showroom. No guide has published a confirmed exact showroom or step yet, so pick a showroom, line up a fast car, and smash out through the glass; if it does not pop, the community guides in the sources are the place to check for the confirmed method.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — follow through on the game there. It is a small, self-contained activity trophy: one visit, one game, done.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — your partner trains alongside you, so the two of you build Strength together instead of one at a time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Rack up 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the criminal life and watch the counter climb.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description hints at a retry: something that takes a second attempt. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so do not chase a specific method — if it has not popped by the time you finish the other trophies, check the community guides linked in the sources for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The most mysterious trophy on the list — even the guides list its unlock method as unconfirmed. The description suggests a strange, surprising event somewhere in Leonida. Do not grind for it blindly; play through the world, and check the community guides in the sources once a confirmed method is published.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock targets over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, with a melee weapon instead of a gun. The bowling name is a joke about the pins going down; line up a slow pass past a group and swing as you roll by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs; launder them by selling them on to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds across the whole game — keep laundering every batch instead of sitting on it.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop. It is cumulative and counts everything you buy along the way — clothes, food, gear — so it usually pops on its own while you gear up for the rest of the list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count — so save up and buy the set, since each one also gives you space to register cars for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register — and from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) and register cheap cars.
